## Phase 0 — context load

Contract read in full; Load list honoured: canonical spec §3/§4 (claim spine,
the defining standard), L3-confidence-program §1 (basis classes), §3.2 GQ-22
(topical relevance, warn-only), §4.3 (the 50+30 weekly stratified sample),
§4.4 (disagreement → S4 maintainer queue), §4.5 (what cannot be claimed —
the verbatim wording table), ADR-128 (`human_eval_*` reserved for the
independent-human machinery), ADR-152 (confidence without independent review),
ADR-153 (derivation not identity), COVERAGE_MATRIX `SIG-CONF-002` (row owned
by this ticket, MISSING at dispatch), `resolution/camera_site_review.py`
(the existing stratum sampler precedent), `resolution/human_eval.py` +
`human_eval_pg.py` (the segregated human machinery this lane never enters),
`resolution/camera_sites.py` (`CameraGoldSet.holdout_label` — the
agent-labelled reference opinion), `resolution/data/camera_site_gold.json`
(the agent-labelled development set), `exports/quality.py` +
`data/quality_checks.toml` (GQ-22: `mode = "report"`, `>= 0.9`, B3, S
placement), `ops/quality.py` (`run_quality_probe`, `FILE_EVALUATORS`,
`SEAM_DEFERRALS`), `tests/db/test_human_eval_pg.py` (role/RLS isolation).

Key design decisions recorded (disclosed in the PR):

- **Quotas.** The 50-site sample = 15 new_sources + 15 possible_duplicates +
  10 dossier_delta_sites + 10 fixed simple_random; the 30-edge sample =
  10 operator_edges + 10 procurement_edges + 10 fixed simple_random. A
  stratum that cannot fill its quota yields headroom to a deterministic
  top-up pass in spec order so the union still reaches 50/30 when the corpus
  allows; a corpus that cannot reach the target records the honest drawn
  counts (a shortfall is surfaced, never smoothed).
- **One drawing stratum per item.** An item may *belong* to several named
  strata; the packet records the stratum that drew it (first draw wins, spec
  order) so every packet item carries exactly one stratum label.
- **Reserved partitions refuse, never silently drop.** Items carrying a
  `partition` in `{calibration, pilot, sealed_final}` are excluded from every
  candidate set; `build_packet` additionally raises if a reserved id would be
  drawn (defence in depth — SIG-EVAL-001).
- **Blindness by construction.** Packet items carry `item_id`, `kind`,
  `stratum`, `question`, `evidence` only; `assert_blind_item` walks each
  evidence payload and raises on any forbidden key (tier, score, weight,
  cluster, label, verdict, decision, model, prompt, context, partition,
  answer, expected, truth, gold, history, …). The two prompt framings are
  different wordings of the same question; neither embeds the other verdict.
- **Records are `sig.agent-review/1` JSONL under
  `docs/build/reports/agent-review/`** — never a `human_eval_*` table.
  Appends dedupe on `record_id` (idempotent re-run, still append-only).
- **Disagreement routing.** Two differing verdicts on one item produce a
  `sig.maintainer-queue-entry/1` row on `maintainer-queue-s4.jsonl`
  (`stratum: S4`, `reason: agent_disagreement`) — a queue entry, not a
  decision. Agreement is recorded as `agent_consensus` in the
  `sig.agent-review-report/1`, carrying the prescribed disclosure: agent–agent
  κ is "agreement between two AI runs", never accuracy.
- **GQ-22 wired as an S-placement file evaluator** (`ops.quality.eval_gq22`)
  reading the appended `sig.agent-review/1` records: measured = the share of
  sampled procurement/agenda/grant items with `agent_consensus: relevant`.
  `mode = "report"` keeps it non-gating by construction (the registry refuses
  a B3 check configured to gate).
- **The camera-site gold set becomes a development set by annotation.** An
  additive `_status` block is appended to `camera_site_gold.json` recording
  `adjudicator: "agent (Claude Opus 5.5), twice"` and
  `status: development` — stored label history is preserved verbatim, never
  rewritten. `decide_auto_write_tiers` already refuses to auto-write any
  inferential tier without B5 certification (`test_honest_evaluation_posture`),
  so the gold set's opinion never gates auto-write; a test now asserts the
  annotation explicitly.

Cross-cutting invariants: append-only everywhere (JSONL dedupe-on-id is
still append-only; the gold annotation adds keys, rewrites nothing);
additive/back-compat (`EvalContext` field defaulted; `--agent-review-dir`
optional; no behaviour change for M/R placements); no unexplained dots —
every packet item carries its drawing stratum and the corpus digest it was
drawn from; no synthetic certainty — unpaired items and shortfalls record
honestly; the stand-in corpus is labelled stand-in in every artifact it
produces (`capture_kind` propagates into the packet + report).

Deviations recorded: none against the contract — the stratum quota split
(15/15/10/10 + 10/10/10) is the ticket's own design space ("named strata +
a fixed simple-random block"), disclosed in the PR body.
